## Limitations (fixed, independent of the outcome)

* Chronos-2 only, 14 datasets, three budgets and four PREDEFINED masks: this is not a search over masks, so it bounds what simple non-contiguous rules achieve, not what the best possible mask achieves.
* Skipping changes the inputs a retained block receives: a non-prefix mask feeds block j a state it never saw in pretraining. Poor accuracy of a mask is therefore a joint effect of the removed computation and this distribution mismatch, and does not show that the skipped blocks are unimportant.
* The adapter is the H3 residual affine map at the final retained block only. Mismatch INSIDE the retained stack is not corrected; per-block adapters or fine-tuning could change the ranking.
* Single-block skipping is a sensitivity diagnostic of the frozen pathway to removing one block, not a measure of intrinsic block importance (interactions between blocks are not measured).
* Latency is measured on one node, three in-job repeats, synthetic contexts; prefix and non-prefix configurations are timed identically in the same job.
